cases.title: 原生 solref 阻尼比与回弹
cases.observation: 固定 timeconst .02 s，阻尼比 .2 / 1 的实测回弹速度比为 0.583149 / 0.136499；该正值 solref 干预同时改变有效刚度。
limitations: positive solref ratio changes effective stiffness as well as damping ratio
no pair override, mesh, multiccd, runtime margin changes or MuJoCo Warp claim
cases.association_scope: Supported MJCF authored raw solref ratio A/B; time constant, priority, solimp, condim and backend fixed.

cases.title: gap 提前检测但不提前激活接触力
cases.observation: gap 0 / .04 m 的首次检测为 0.0905 / 0.0505 s；首次激活均为 0.0905 s。较大 gap 提供 80 个提前检测但无力样本，A/B 轨迹等价。
limitations: positive solref ratio changes effective stiffness as well as damping ratio
no pair override, mesh, multiccd, runtime margin changes or MuJoCo Warp claim
cases.association_scope: Only gap varied directly; margin fixed geometric activation reference, not a margin A/B sweep.
